axis.zh: 从左下的基座斜指向右上、带折角的黄色信号板
axis.en: a yellow folded signal panel ascending from a lower-left base toward the upper right

curves.zh: 宽窄不一的绿海藻与柔性管线
curves.en: ribbons of green kelp and flexible lines of varied widths

micro_scene.zh: 右下偏中的白色扇贝形检修舱
micro_scene.en: a white scallop-shaped service pod just right of center and below the midpoint

figures.zh: 三位穿深色便装的维修员
figures.en: the three technicians in dark casual clothes

backdrop.zh: 潮水退后的海底气象站
backdrop.en: an underwater weather station in an imagined low-tide moment

soft_forms.zh: 右上悬挂的两枚浅蓝浮标
soft_forms.en: two pale-blue floats hanging in the upper right

rules.zh: 绘制「潮汐信号维修站」：一位维修员坐在主板左下基座，第二位从打开的白色舱口探身，第三位在右侧扶住一条绿管线。旁边散放珊瑚红线缆卷、扁青色盒和淡橙色浮筒。
rules.en: Depict a tidal signal repair station: one technician sits at the lower-left base of the panel, a second leans out of the open white hatch, and a third steadies a green line on the right. Scatter a coral cable spool, a flat aqua case and a pale orange buoy nearby.
rules.check: 逐一核对三个人物的位置与动作。

rules.zh: 输出单张约 4:3 横幅，无标题、标识及可读文字。使用潮汐设施的专属物件与新布局。
rules.en: Deliver one approximately 4:3 landscape illustration, with no heading, logos or readable text. Use objects and a layout specific to the tidal station.
rules.check: 核对横幅比例、文字及题材残留。
